name: av_earnings
description:
Earnings per share history for one company from Alpha Vantage (EARNINGS).
Returns: {symbol, annualEarnings: [{fiscalDateEnding, reportedEPS}], quarterlyEarnings: [{fiscalDateEnding, reportedDate, reportedEPS, estimatedEPS, surprise, surprisePercentage}]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker).
Upcoming dates: yf_earnings_dates or yf_calendar; Yahoo's EPS surprise view: yf_earnings_history.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM"}
